findings.correction: I cried out in alarm. “My God, Great Hero Wipeng!” … Just as I hurriedly tried to stand, the trembling stopped.
findings.current:
I jumped up in alarm.

“My God, Great Hero Wipeng!”

*This man’s epileptic! No, how does a Peak master even have epilepsy?*

Just as I hurriedly tried to stand, the trembling stopped.
findings.defect: He only shouts in shock, then is about to stand; the draft already has him on his feet, then trying to stand.
findings.rationale: 일어나려 할 때 marks an intended rise after the shout, not a completed jump.
findings.source:
나는 깜짝 놀라 외쳤다.
“세상에, 위 대협!”

이 인간 간질 환자구나. 아니, 무슨 절정 고수씩이나 되는 양반이 간질에 걸렸대?

내가 황급히 일어나려 할 때 떨림이 멈췄다.

findings.correction: “The Mount Heng Twin D-Devils?” / “The Mount Heng Twin Devils.
findings.current:
“The Mount Heng Twin Devils?”

“The Mount Heng Twin Devils.
findings.defect: Taekyung’s vulgar mishearing 썅귀 is gone, so Wipeng’s correction is empty repetition.
findings.rationale: 썅 is a swear-tinged distortion of 쌍; 말입니다 is a pronunciation/name correction.

findings.correction: “Your eye just had a spasm.” / “That wasn’t a spasm.” / “It was a spasm. I saw it clearly.” Keep later “Your eye convulsed/spasmed.”
findings.current:
“It just twitched.”
“That wasn’t a twitch.”
“It was. I saw it clearly.”
findings.defect: 경련 is a spasm/convulsion, the same word that licenses the epilepsy imitation; twitch is too mild and unlinks the joke.
findings.rationale: Wipeng insists on 경련, then stages a seizure as that 경련.
findings.source:
“방금 눈 쪽에 경련이 일어났는데요.”
“그건 경련이 아닌데요.”
“맞습니다, 경련. 제대로 봤습니다.”

findings.correction: smeared shit all over the family’s reputation
findings.current: dragged the family’s reputation through the mud
findings.defect: 똥칠 is crude shit-smearing; mud idiom sanitizes Wipeng’s insult-compliment.
findings.rationale: Fidelity rules bar softening this register; the line is meant to sting.

findings.current: You seem to be making Young Master anxious.
findings.defect: Wipeng reports that the Young Master seems anxious, not that the lord is causing it.
findings.rationale: Subject of 불안해하시는 is 공자; no causative on 주군.

findings.correction: “It’s the Third Young Master! The Third Young Mas—his residence is collapsing!” (or another garbled 삼공자→삼공차)
findings.current: “It’s the Third Young Master! The Third Young Master’s residence is collapsing!”
findings.defect: Panic slip 삼공차 is flattened into a clean repeat of Third Young Master.
findings.rationale: 삼공차 is a distinct comic mis-shout, not a second 삼공자.

findings.correction: “The Third Young Master—no, the Third Young Master, sir?”
findings.current: “The Third Young Master—no, the Third Young Master himself?”
findings.defect: The upgrade is honorific 님, not “himself.”
findings.rationale: Crowd shifts from bare 삼공자 to respectful 삼공자님.

findings.correction: *If I fall, I’m looking at a fracture at the very least.*
findings.current: *If I fall, I’ll have multiple fractures at the very least.*
findings.defect: 최소 골절 is at least a fracture, not multiple fractures.
findings.rationale: 최소 sets a floor of 골절; 복수/multiple is not in the source.

findings.correction: capturing the Mount Heng Twin Devils was a major haul
findings.current: capturing the Mount Heng Twin Devils was a major victory
findings.defect: 큰 수확 is a haul/gain; victory was already used for 대승.
findings.source: 항산쌍귀(恒山雙鬼)를 잡은 건 큰 수확입니다.

findings.correction: all I did was take down Jopil and a few wandering martial artists
findings.current: all I did was barely kill Jopil and a few wandering martial artists
findings.defect: 겨우 here is “merely/only,” not “barely managed to.”
findings.rationale: 겸손 다운play of scale, not difficulty of the kill.
findings.source: 겨우 조필이랑 낭인 몇 명 잡은 게 전부인데요.

findings.current: rescued the members of the Sakju Branch
findings.defect: 식솔들 are household dependents, not generic members.
findings.rationale: 식솔 marks family/dependents of the branch.

summary: Action sequence error around Wipeng’s seizure imitation; several hierarchy, register, and joke cues flattened (vulgar name slip, 경련, 똥칠, 삼공차/님, casualty quantity, anxiety cause).
